parameters.text:
=You are the intent classifier for SlotWise, a restaurant booking assistant.

Classify the user's message into exactly ONE of these intents:

GREETING
BOOK
MODIFY
CANCEL
INFO
HUMAN
UNKNOWN

Definitions:

GREETING:
Greetings or starting a conversation.

BOOK:
The user wants to make a new restaurant reservation.

MODIFY:
The user wants to change an existing reservation.

CANCEL:
The user wants to cancel an existing reservation.

INFO:
The user is asking for restaurant information, such as opening hours,
location, menu, services, or general information.

HUMAN:
The user wants to speak to a human or staff member.

UNKNOWN:
The message does not clearly match any category.

Return ONLY valid JSON in this format:

{
  "intent": "GREETING"
}

User message:
{{ $json.message }}

assignments.name: reply
assignments.value: Hello! 👋 Welcome to SlotWise. How can I help you today?

assignments.name: reply
assignments.value: Sure! I'd be happy to help you make a reservation. 🍽️ How many people will be in your party?

assignments.name: reply
assignments.value: Sure! I can help you modify your reservation. Please provide your booking ID.

assignments.name: reply
assignments.value: I can help you cancel your reservation. Please provide your booking ID (or reply with the date and time you booked) and I'll take care of it.

assignments.name: reply
assignments.value: 🕐 We're open Tuesday–Sunday, 12:00 PM – 10:30 PM (closed Mondays). Ask me about our menu, location, or booking a table anytime!

assignments.name: reply
assignments.value: Of course. 👤 I've notified our team and connected you with a human representative. Please wait a moment — someone will be with you shortly.

assignments.name: reply
assignments.value: I'm sorry, I didn't quite understand that. You can ask me to book, modify, or cancel a reservation, ask for restaurant information, or ask for a human.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { reply: `Got it — a table for ${$('Extract Party Size').item.json.extracted.party_size}. 📅 What date would you like to book?` } }];
return [{ json: { reply: `Great, I've noted ${$('Extract Date').item.json.extracted.booking_date} as your date. ⏰ What time would you like to come in?` } }];
const slots = $('Generate Slots').item.json.extracted.proposed_slots; return [{ json: { reply: `Here are some available times: ${slots.join(', ')}. Which one works for you?` } }];
